A core topic send with receipts skips an unresponsive recipient before any forward to its agent subject, so nothing stores its copy, and the 200 answer does not name it. R3's last sentence and A3 fail.

defaultSessionReapInterval is 5 minutes; the spec, the plan and four docs say 1 minute. The maximum age is read only on that pass, so A1 and A7's 2-minute adoption fails at the default. The role reaper now shares the interval (spec: 5 minutes, unchanged).
R7: envoy_role_get throws on the 404 holder_lapsed and the error text has no state; envoy_send drops last_seen; envoy_publish shows no state; the 200 role lookup (api.go) has no holder_state.

A8: grep -l unresponsive misses packages/envoy/AGENTS.md and skills/dispatch/SKILL.md; AGENTS.md still says a lookup or a role delivery releases a lapsed claim. Four skills and the docs site say a publish to an unresponsive holder fails with receipt_timeout; the listener answers 404 holder_lapsed.
Three hand-edited dist files, against packages/claude-envoy/AGENTS.md:299 (a pull request never commits dist/).
A5's browser cases for the Agents page and route status holder_unresponsive are missing, and the pull request quotes no run that fails before the change and passes at its head.

The role reaper now runs on the 2 s rig interval, so it can release the claim between the gone read and the assertion that the claim is unchanged: a CI flake. ROLE_REAP_INTERVAL_MS, its comment and the ci.yaml timeout raise are stale.

No Contract change census, though the change adds refusals (503 refilling on /v1/sessions, /v1/interests/ and GET /api/v1/agents; 409 on another agent's claim or release of an unresponsive holder; 404 for an unresponsive serving-port session) and changes the role 404 (claim_released always false) and send answers.
WithLastSeenRetention(15 minutes) overrides session.LastSeenMemory (2 hours).
The revision-0 fallback deletes without judging the record again and counts a key the bucket did not hold.
The unread count reads from FirstSeq, so the 500 cap is spent before last_seen; each read gets no pass deadline.
envoy_sends_unresponsive_total counts failed publishes and duplicates.
An unresponsive architect's notice logs 'outbox row failed' at ERROR on every retry.
Shutdown's 1 s deadline cuts the 5 s settle and DELETE R7 asks for; the fragment says 5 s.
The clean stop's unconditional DELETE runs on a goroutine and can land after the relaunched session registered.
A stored roster row the previous release wrote has no state, so every route reads no_holder.
An unresponsive holder past takeable_at still reads as holding; the Unclaimed filter hides an issue any agent may take.
The chip does not say unresponsive since last_seen (R5).
Get's meaning follows the bucket's maximum age; the serving-port push paths use it, and two doc comments say they use sessionIsLive.
envDuration takes 0 or a negative value; ENVOY_SESSION_REAP_INTERVAL=0 panics time.NewTicker.
Two CHANGELOG.md files edited (one entry with an issue key); move it to a fragment.
dispatch_issues list rows read claim holding from list membership (liveSessionTitles), so an unresponsive holder shows no marker.
Tool text says 'unresponsive for more than 20 minutes'; the rule is 20 minutes from last_seen.
The takeable rule is written twice (claimBlockedBy, claimLiveness); session.IsLive has no caller.
